seriesTitle: The Last Night at Tremore Beach

episodes.title: No salgas de casa
episodes.summary: Two years after an unsettling episode, Álex tries to find inspiration as a pianist in the small town of Tremore. One night, a storm stirs up his world.

episodes.title: Blanchard
episodes.summary: Álex grows even more worried after his kids arrive. While he battles his visions, a dinner at Leo and María's leads to a perplexing surprise.

episodes.title: Una vez estuve muerta
episodes.summary: Intrigued by his neighbors, Álex visits the police station. His growing feelings for Judy are disrupted when his visions begin to threaten her.

episodes.title: Para Judy
episodes.summary: Judy reveals a traumatic incident that eventually brought her to Tremore. Her story prompts Álex to adopt a new perspective on his visions.

episodes.title: Mamá
episodes.summary: Álex delves into the depths of his psyche to unearth forgotten memories about his complicated relationship with his mother.

episodes.title: Pueblo pequeño, infierno grande
episodes.summary: The sense of danger intensifies during Tremore's festivities. Leo and María remain distant. A missing piece resurfaces, completing Estrella's puzzle.

episodes.title: Tenemos que irnos
episodes.summary: Breaking news prompts Álex to restart his investigation and immerse himself in his visions. The police get involved when things get out of control.

episodes.title: La última noche
episodes.summary: Past and present collide as Álex confronts the nightmare he's been running from, and nothing is as it seems. Is there time to build a brighter future?
